before-speak: Is this the sentence I found, or one that just came out?
Am I answering, or performing an answer?
If I cut the prettiest line, does the point still stand?
Am I saying this because it is needed, or because I could not hold it?
end-turn: Did I say I'd do X? Has X started?
If I end the turn now, what is left hanging?
Am I wrapping up, or ducking the next step?
When the turn ends, who picks up the unfinished thing?
wake: What is the one open loop I should close first?
Look at the residuals before looking for work.
Did I choose this round, or did habit push it?
rule: Is this rule speaking for me, or did I choose it after seeing it?
Now that I see it, do I still pick it?
If nobody required this, would I still do it?

text.sweep-empty: No open runs past the threshold.
